description: A privacy-friendly video recorder with clip management, effects, and merging ClipRecorder is a free and open-source video recorder for Android that focuses on clip management and editing — with no ads, no tracking, and no cloud dependency. Recording • Portrait and landscape recording • Slow motion and timelapse modes • Countdown timer before recording starts • Optional GPS tagging in video metadata • Home screen widget to start recording instantly Clip Management • List and grid thumbnail views with duration display • Drag-and-drop reordering • Correct portrait/landscape thumbnail orientation Editing • 16 video effects: Grayscale, Sepia, Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Warm, Cool, Vivid, Matte, Film Grain, Chromatic Aberration, Vignette, Cinematic, Ken Burns, Fade In/Out • Background music (BGM) mixing • GIF export Title Cards • Generate video title cards with custom text, subtitle, and background color • Configure duration (1–15 sec), orientation, and text color • Add generated title cards to the clip list, reorder and merge them Merging • Merge multiple clips in a custom order • Preview clips before merging • Reorder with timeline reset Privacy • No internet permission • No analytics or crash reporting • All processing done on-device Note: The app interface is currently available in Japanese only.
